// # Data series

// Named sequences of measured values: plain series, regular and irregular time

//==
// # Series

// A named sequence of numeric values sharing one unit: a plot trace, a sensor
// sweep, a spectrum row.
type DataSeries
{
    Name: String;
    Values: Array<Number>;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}
